decision_basis: parent failed review plus train-only residual and exclusive ownership audit; no successor validation used to select features or rules
operator_fit: fixed shared source-balanced relative Ridge alpha=1 for Add; exact fields in protocol; no parameter sweep; Mul candidate coefficients copied unchanged
G_fit: same source-balanced relative NNLS basis as parent, adding preregistered carry-segment variation; no per-shape correction
S_boundary_fit: fixed common relative Ridge alpha=1 using protocol control features per semantic path class, only train; reserve maximum positive leave-one-training-source-out residual
S_area: retain native/external coefficients and parent input-service correction; validate reuse separately

shared_fit.shared_physical: reuse the frozen parent physical-area function unchanged
shared_fit.method: source-balanced relative NNLS; train only; semantic functional footprint and corrected disjoint root labels

support.bounds: min/max structural features of train; no exact-T bins
support.radius: maximum leave-one-train-source-out k-neighbor normalized distance times1.05
support.price_qualification: structural membership never by itself grants a price; all validation residuals reported regardless of rejection

tests: old and new locked_test remain locked until candidate/features/support/reserves/implementation and dependencies freeze; no automatic unlock or publication
validation_roles: all inherited validation retains validation role; new preregistered validation reported separately; consumed historical validation is regression evidence, not independent testing
